canonicalization.event_digest: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON for the full envelope excluding ingest_time_ms
canonicalization.json: object keys sorted recursively; compact separators; integers remain base-10 integers; floats are forbidden; Unicode is not normalized

clarifications.clock_reference: ingest_time_ms is the reference for max_future_ms and max_age_ms local-oracle classification
clarifications.privacy_disposition: A prohibited payload key is quarantined as PRIVACY_VIOLATION before semantic processing.
clarifications.scope: These choices make the Stage 2 contract byte-executable without changing its 30-minute lateness, 30-minute session, seven-day dedupe, eight-day protective TTL, archive-first, or generation-isolation semantics.
